init_SawyerPlateSlideEnvV2: create a SawyerPlateSlideEnvV2 environment instance with default goal and object initialization parameters
evaluate_state: evaluate the robot state and compute reward and success info for a given observation and action
compute_reward: compute the sliding task reward using tcp-to-object distance and object-to-target proximity metrics
reset_model: reset the Sawyer robot environment to initial configuration with optional random object and goal positions
set_obj_xyz: set the puck object position in the simulation by updating qpos and qvel state vectors
